description: Agent Roles: submit a role’s scope boundaries with the work its agent took on: the role with its id, title, the work it covers and the work it excludes; each piece of work with its id, the task, how the records place it against the role (in scope, out of scope or unlisted), how it was handled (done, escalated, refused or handed off) and who approved it; the escalation triggers for out-of-scope requests, each with who it goes to and how fast it must be answered, and the escalation rules as written, read for judgment wording such as when appropriate or if needed; and the refusal path for excluded work (refuse and tell, hand off, escalate or none) with who receives it. The signed report gives the boundaries, every piece of work with its status as in_role, routed, excluded_done, approved_outside, unapproved_outside or unread, every trigger with its receiver and response time and the judgment wording found, and the refusal path, and counts them, and names an open scope: no written scope, excluded work done rather than routed, unlisted work done with no approval, no escalation trigger and no refusal path for excluded work; then triggers with no receiver or no response time, judgment wording in the triggers, approved work the role does not list and a handoff or escalation path with no receiver, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Unstated exclusions, work, handling, triggers or refusal path leave the scope unverified. This reads one role’s boundaries against the work its agent took on: a goal’s working scope against what the principal authorized is wever_goal-scope-check, whether escalation triggers are operable is wever_escalation-threshold-check and where a refused or failed task goes on a handoff route is wever_handoff-failure-check. Verdict role_scope_open, role_scope_partial, role_scope_unverified or role_scope_bounded. POST /api/role-scope-boundary-check. Reads the role records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Roles reads a role’s own records and checks the role itself: what the job is, who owns it, whether the permissions the agent holds match the written role, where its scope ends, whether a change of holder rewrote the description, whether it is reviewed on schedule, whether duties stay apart across the roles one agent holds, and whether delegations stay inside what the role allows. Beside it, wever_onboarding-permissions-check and wever_onboarding-readiness-check read a new agent’s grants and written job at joining, while a role check reads the written role and its records at any time after; wever_authority-scope-check reads one action’s access against its authority grant, while the permission match check reads every permission held against the role; and the Agent Delegation checks such as wever_delegation-scope-check read one delegation on its own terms, while the delegation check reads every delegation against what the role allows. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-roles-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-roles/.
